name: Northstar Seed Pitch
description: A founder pitch for making presentations programmable through OPF and the hosted PPTX.dev engine.
author: Northstar Foundry
purpose: Raise a $4M seed round to harden the rendering engine and expand SDK distribution.
takeaway: Presentations are becoming a programmable output format for AI agents.
OPF gives teams one stable contract for authoring, preview, and export.

narrative.name: Seed Pitch
narrative.summary: Problem, solution, proof, and ask for an infrastructure startup.

slides.title: Presentations should be programmable, not handcrafted bottlenecks.
slides.subtitle: Northstar turns narrative and design intent into OPF that can validate, preview, and export.
slides.notes: Open with the cost of quarterly deck rebuilds and the shift toward agent-generated business artifacts.

slides.title: Deck production still breaks at the exact moment teams need speed.

items.text: Teams rebuild the same strategic decks from scratch every quarter.
items.description: Narrative, numbers, and brand rules drift across versions.

items.text: Generated slides collapse when output leaves the brand system.
items.description: Most pipelines stop at screenshots instead of editable decks.

items.text: Agents lack a stable presentation contract.
items.description: They need structured intent, not pixel-by-pixel instructions.

slides.title: OPF makes every deck step speak the same contract.

left.text: Describe the presentation once as OpenPresentation JSON, then reuse it across validation, browser preview, PPTX export, SDKs, and automation.

items: Root metadata captures audience, purpose, tone, and duration.
Design references gallery themes, color schemes, fonts, and dimensions.
Slides use canonical payloads like text, lists, charts, tables, metrics, and timelines.

slides.title: Developer demand is moving from exports to full deck systems.
slides.subtitle: Qualified pipeline grew as teams tested OPF-powered workflows.

slides.title: We are raising to make OPF the default contract for AI-generated presentations.
slides.text: The seed round funds generator fidelity, public SDK distribution, and the hosted engine reliability needed for agent developers to build on PPTX.dev.
